item.title: Photos: ECU women's basketball team wins on National Girls & Women in Sports Day
item.description: On Wednesday, the ECU women's basketball team continued its impressive season with a win over South Florida at home for the first time in 11 years. The game was part of National Girls & Women in Sports Day.

item.title: The military’s frequent flyers at Washington-Warren Airport
item.description: Washington-Warren Airport has become a regular training and refueling stop for V-22 Osprey aircraft, bringing frequent flights, hot-fueling ops and a boost to local fuel sales.

item.title: Jonathan Russell named Municipal Manager of the Year
item.description: Jonathan Russell is named NCCCMA’s 2025 Municipal Manager of the Year, honored for steady leadership, innovative problem solving and strong community engagement.

item.title: Write Again… He was a survivor
item.description: Tuesday, January 27, was International Holocaust Remembrance Day. A day set aside to pause, reflect, and attempt to understand how such evil could have taken place. Would that every American, regardless of age, was knowledgeable about the most horrific time of the 20th century. Of any century. If every school, public and private, would take just one class period to tell about the Holocaust each year, that would be good. item.title: The art of reading your landscape in winter
item.description: Written by Angela Mason Foster Extension Master Gardener Volunteer February may feel like the quietest month in the garden, but it is secretly one of the most revealing.
